description: PLAN A2 baseline of the kubeadm cluster with Cilium in VXLAN tunnel mode and kube-proxy kept. Two test pods on different workers exercise pod to pod traffic, cluster DNS, a ClusterIP Service and a NetworkPolicy, while the management and lab NICs of both workers are captured.

checks.description: Every host of k8s_cluster is a Ready Node whose InternalIP is its k8s_node_ip.
A Cilium agent pod runs with every container ready on every node.
checks.detail: cp1 cilium-6tcb8; worker1 cilium-6zshk; worker2 cilium-4vtm4

checks.description: The server and client pods run Ready on their two workers, with pod IPs inside their nodes' pod CIDRs.
checks.detail: server 10.244.1.160 on worker1, client 10.244.2.219 on worker2

checks.description: The client fetches the server pod's name over HTTP from the server pod IP on the other worker.
checks.detail: http://10.244.1.160:8080/ returned 'server' after 1 attempts, last exit 0 'server'

checks.description: Cluster DNS in the client pod resolves the test Service and kubernetes.default to their ClusterIPs.
The client fetches the server pod's name over HTTP through the ClusterIP Service name.
After a default-deny ingress NetworkPolicy, the same request from the client times out.
checks.detail: the request was blocked after 2 attempts, last exit 1 'wget: download timed out\ncommand terminated with exit code 1'

checks.description: After a NetworkPolicy that admits the client label, the same request succeeds again.
checks.detail: the request succeeded after 1 attempts, last exit 0 'server'

checks.description: Management NIC captures of both workers hold VXLAN frames on Cilium's tunnel port between the two node IPs, with the client and server pod IPs inside, in both directions.
checks.detail: worker1 enp0s5 55 VXLAN frames on UDP 8472; worker2 enp0s5 125 VXLAN frames on UDP 8472

checks.description: Lab NIC captures of both workers over the same interval hold no VXLAN frame and no frame to or from the pod CIDR, while the marker pings over the lab NIC show the capture was live.
checks.detail: worker1 enp0s4 0 VXLAN, 0 pod CIDR, 14 ICMP echo; worker2 enp0s4 0 VXLAN, 0 pod CIDR, 16 ICMP echo

checks.description: The run's namespace and every object in it are gone at the end.
checks.detail: namespace rfl-20261115t055930z and every object labeled rdma-fabric-lab/run=20261115T055930Z are gone

checks.description: After the run no process carrying this run id remains on either worker.
checks.detail: cp1: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining; worker1: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining; worker2: 0 stopped by the runner, 0 remaining

security.device_exposure: Test pods are unprivileged busybox containers with no host path, host network or device. kubectl runs on the first control plane with its admin.conf, which never leaves that guest. tcpdump and process cleanup use sudo on the workers.
